review.use_summary: Converted bedtools genomecov bedGraph of one-base Micro-C contact junctions to bigWig, then used that track as a deepTools sample input.
review.implementation_scope_note: The converter does not construct junction coordinates, run genomecov or perform downstream deepTools analyses. Converter edition, chromosome-size input, precision, compression and zoom settings are unstated; the linked binary directory is not a pinned edition.

review.use_summary: Sorted MACS2 ChIP-seq pileup bedGraph with sort -k1,1 -k2,2n, then converted it with BedGraphToBigWig for genome-browser visualization and downstream deepTools gene-centred analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: The source specifies the T. gondii TGME49 reference and the sort command, but no exact converter edition or chromosome-size input. The sort locale is unstated. MACS2 peak calling, deepTools binning/clustering and nf-core/HOMER analyses are separate steps, not converter options.

review.use_summary: Generated bigWig tracks with UCSC bedGraphToBigWig, reported as v4, after Nanopore modified-base processing and partitioning sites into AT, AA, AC and AG contexts.
review.implementation_scope_note: Preserve the literal reported v4: its relationship to converter release versus BBI file format is unresolved; do not relabel it as current converter2.10. Reference assemblies are listed separately, while the converter chromosome-size input and options are unstated. Guppy/modbam2bed calls, sequence-context extraction and deepTools methylation summaries are separate steps.

review.use_summary: Converted MACS2 ATAC-seq bedGraph pileup tracks to bigWig after processing mm10 embryo reads and calling peaks on separate and merged biological replicates.
review.implementation_scope_note: Converter edition, exact chromosome-size input and conversion options are unstated. The reported MACS2 shift/extension/duplicate settings and replicate-confidence peak selection do not belong to bedGraphToBigWig. The converter does not merge reads, call peaks or establish replicate reproducibility.
